title: rosa canina f. aspernata
intro: Rosa canina f. aspernata, commonly known as the Wild Bramble or Pyrenean Rose, is a fragrant, white-flowered shrub belonging to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Rosa canina f. aspernata include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues and its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina f. aspernata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
